sections.heading: Justin Bieber — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Justin Bieber was born on 1 March 1994 in London, and holds Canadian nationality. He was given the name Justin Drew Bieber at birth and is publicly known as Justin Bieber.
Public records name his father, Jeremy Bieber and his mother, Pattie Mallette. He is a sibling of Jazmyn Bieber and Jaxon Bieber.
He studied at St. Michael Catholic Secondary School, Stratford District Secondary School and Jeanne Sauvé Catholic School.
He is recorded as speaking Canadian English and English.

sections.heading: Justin Bieber — Career and Professional Work
paras: Justin Bieber works primarily as a singer, songwriter, musician, guitarist, television producer and skateboarder.
He has taken part in Ice Bucket Challenge.
